blocks.en: Section 0: Introduction & Component Classification

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解輔助包裝組件（Auxiliary Packaging Components）的定義與功能，以及其在固體口服劑型保護中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the definition and function of auxiliary packaging components, and their role in protecting solid oral dosage forms

blocks.zh: 辨識三大類主要輔助包裝組件：藥用棉卷（Pharmaceutical Coil）、乾燥劑（Desiccants）、以及除臭吸附劑（Odor Adsorbents）
blocks.en: Identify the three main categories of auxiliary packaging components: pharmaceutical coil, desiccants, and odor adsorbents

blocks.zh: 掌握棉製、嫘縈（Rayon）及聚酯（Polyester）藥用棉卷的鑑別試驗方法與驗收標準
blocks.en: Master the identification test methods and acceptance criteria for cotton, rayon, and polyester pharmaceutical coil

blocks.zh: 了解各類乾燥劑的化學特性、外觀特徵及適用範圍
blocks.en: Understand the chemical properties, appearance, and scope of use of each type of desiccant

blocks.zh: 認識 USP 〈670〉 的監管地位及其與其他 USP 章節的交叉引用關係
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory status of USP <670> and its cross-references to other USP chapters

blocks.zh: Overview — 章節概覽
blocks.en: Overview

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Auxiliary Packaging Components（輔助包裝組件）：不直接接觸藥品活性成分，而是透過改善包裝環境來保護產品的輔助材料。例如乾燥劑防止水分侵入，棉卷防止錠劑在運輸中破損。
blocks.en: Auxiliary Packaging Components: Supporting materials that do not contact the active ingredient directly but protect the product by improving the packaging environment. For example, desiccants prevent moisture ingress, and coil prevents tablets from breaking during transport.

blocks.zh: Container–Closure System（容器密封系統）：USP 對藥品包裝完整性的核心框架。輔助包裝組件是在這個系統中「加值」的額外元素，而非主體結構。
blocks.en: Container-Closure System: The core USP framework for pharmaceutical packaging integrity. Auxiliary packaging components are extra elements that "add value" within this system; they are not the primary structure.

blocks.zh: 交叉引用原則：USP 〈670〉 不是孤立文件。它明確要求組件也要符合其他指定章節的要求，如 〈731〉 Loss on Drying、〈281〉 Residue on Ignition、〈791〉 pH 等。
blocks.en: Cross-reference principle: USP <670> is not a stand-alone document. It expressly requires components to also meet the requirements of other specified chapters, such as <731> Loss on Drying, <281> Residue on Ignition, and <791> pH.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一個高檔珠寶禮盒：主角是珠寶（藥品），盒子是容器密封系統，而填充在盒內的天鵝絨襯墊與防潮包——那就是輔助包裝組件。它們不是主角，但少了它們，主角可能在運送途中受損。
blocks.en: Imagine a high-end jewelry gift box: the star is the jewelry (the drug product), the box is the container-closure system, and the velvet lining and anti-moisture packet inside are the auxiliary packaging components. They are not the star, but without them the star might be damaged in transit.

blocks.zh: 在製藥包裝中，乾燥劑就像那個防潮包，棉卷就像那個天鵝絨——都是為了讓藥品安全抵達患者手中。
blocks.en: In pharmaceutical packaging, the desiccant is like that anti-moisture packet and the coil is like that velvet, both there so the medicine reaches the patient safely.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 監管現況（2026年視角）：本章於 2024 年 3 月正式生效，2025 年 2 月確認為現行官方版本。任何 FDA 審查都可能引用此版本。CDMO 在選擇輔助包裝組件時，必須確保供應商符合最新 USP 版本要求。
blocks.en: Regulatory status (2026 perspective): This chapter became official in March 2024 and was confirmed as the current official version in February 2025. Any FDA review may cite this version. When selecting auxiliary packaging components, a CDMO must ensure that suppliers comply with the latest USP version.

blocks.zh: 「其他指定章節」意涵：這個交叉引用讓 USP 〈670〉 的要求變得更廣泛——光滿足本章不夠，還必須符合諸如 〈661〉、〈671〉 等相關容器章節的附加要求。
blocks.en: Meaning of "other specified chapters": This cross-reference makes the requirements of USP <670> broader. Meeting this chapter alone is not enough; the additional requirements of related container chapters such as <661> and <671> must also be met.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果一個 CDMO 客戶要求你為其口服固體劑型產品選擇包裝，你如何判斷是否需要加入輔助包裝組件？
blocks.en: If a CDMO client asks you to select packaging for an oral solid dosage form product, how would you decide whether auxiliary packaging components are needed?

blocks.zh: USP 〈670〉 說「不限於」這些組件，這對法規合規性有什麼潛在影響？
blocks.en: USP <670> says these components are "not limited to" those listed. What potential impact does this have on regulatory compliance?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 要求這些組件「同時」符合本章及其他指定章節的要求，而不是只選一個標準？
blocks.en: Why does USP require these components to meet both this chapter and the other specified chapters, rather than choosing just one standard?

blocks.zh: Pharmaceutical Coil — 藥用棉卷
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Coil

blocks.zh: Pharmaceutical Coil（藥用棉卷）：用於多劑量容器（如藥瓶）中防止固體口服劑型在運輸過程中因振動而破損的填充材料。三種主要材質：棉（Cotton）、嫘縈（Rayon）、聚酯（Polyester）。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Coil: Filler material used in multiple-unit containers (such as bottles) to prevent solid oral dosage forms from breaking due to vibration during transport. There are three main materials: cotton, rayon, and polyester.

blocks.zh: 重要警告：棉卷在開瓶後必須丟棄。這是安全使用指示，若患者誤以為棉卷有藥效而保留，可能成為污染源。
blocks.en: Important warning: The coil must be discarded after the bottle is opened. This is a safe-use instruction; if patients mistakenly believe the coil has a therapeutic effect and keep it, it may become a source of contamination.

blocks.zh: 試劑系統：碘化氯化鋅溶液（碘試劑）、氯化鋅甲酸溶液（溶解性試劑）、DuPont No. 4 染色液（纖維鑑別）——三種試劑分工明確，分別測試纖維的物理化學特性。
blocks.en: Reagent systems: Iodinated zinc chloride solution (iodine reagent), zinc chloride-formic acid solution (solubility reagent), and DuPont No. 4 stain (fiber identification). The three reagents have clearly separate roles, each testing a different physical or chemical property of the fiber.

blocks.zh: 藥用棉卷就像雞蛋盒裡的泡棉格：它的任務是吸收衝擊、防止主角（藥片）破損，而不是讓消費者吃下去的東西。USP 特別強調「開瓶後應丟棄」，正是因為患者可能誤以為棉卷是藥品的一部分。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical coil is like the foam dividers in an egg carton: its job is to absorb shock and keep the star (the tablets) from breaking, not to be something the consumer swallows. USP stresses "discard after opening" precisely because patients may mistake the coil for part of the medicine.

blocks.zh: 棉花的三種鑑別試驗（顏色反應、溶解性、染色）就像三道關卡的身份驗證——通過三道才能確認是真正的藥用等級棉花，而非工業用棉。
blocks.en: The three identification tests for cotton (color reaction, solubility, staining) are like a three-gate identity check: only by passing all three can the material be confirmed as true pharmaceutical-grade cotton rather than industrial cotton.

blocks.zh: 殘留過氧化氫（Residual Hydrogen Peroxide）的重要性：棉花製造時可能使用漂白程序（H₂O₂），若殘留量過高（>50 ppm），可能導致藥品氧化降解。這是 USP 特別設置此測試的原因，也是 CDMO 採購棉卷時必須要求供應商提供的 CoA 數據。
blocks.en: Importance of residual hydrogen peroxide: A bleaching process (H₂O₂) may be used in cotton manufacturing, and if the residual level is too high (>50 ppm), it may cause oxidative degradation of the drug product. This is why USP includes this test, and it is also CoA data that a CDMO must require from the supplier when purchasing coil.

blocks.zh: 螢光測試的意義：過度的藍色螢光暗示棉花可能含有螢光增白劑（optical brighteners），這類化學物質在藥品包裝中屬於潛在污染物。
blocks.en: Significance of the fluorescence test: Excessive blue fluorescence suggests that the cotton may contain optical brighteners, chemicals that are considered potential contaminants in pharmaceutical packaging.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
殘留過氧化氫計算（Cotton Coil）：

% H₂O₂ = [(mL of Titrant × 0.0017) / 20] × 100

換算為 ppm：
ppm H₂O₂ = % H₂O₂ (w/w) × 10,000

驗收標準：NMT 50 ppm（兩種方法均適用）
blocks.en:
Residual hydrogen peroxide calculation (cotton coil):

% H₂O₂ = [(mL of Titrant × 0.0017) / 20] × 100

Conversion to ppm:
ppm H₂O₂ = % H₂O₂ (w/w) × 10,000

Acceptance criterion: NMT 50 ppm (applies to both methods)

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO 品保人員，當你審查一個新的棉卷供應商時，你應該要求供應商提供哪些 CoA（Certificate of Analysis）項目？
blocks.en: As a CDMO QA professional reviewing a new coil supplier, which CoA (Certificate of Analysis) items should you require from the supplier?

blocks.zh: 至少應包含：Loss on Drying（≤8.0%）、Residue on Ignition（≤0.20%）、殘留 H₂O₂（≤50 ppm）、水溶性物質（≤0.35%）、油脂含量（≤0.7%）、以及纖維鑑別（A、B、C、D 四項測試）。
blocks.en: At a minimum: Loss on Drying (≤8.0%), Residue on Ignition (≤0.20%), residual H₂O₂ (≤50 ppm), water-soluble substances (≤0.35%), fatty matter (≤0.7%), and fiber identification (four tests: A, B, C, and D).

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 要為棉花設計四項不同的鑑別試驗（A、B、C、D），而不是只用一項就夠？
blocks.en: Why does USP design four different identification tests (A, B, C, D) for cotton rather than relying on a single one?

blocks.zh: 棉卷的殘留過氧化氫上限是 50 ppm，這個數字是根據什麼安全考量設定的？
blocks.en: The residual hydrogen peroxide limit for cotton coil is 50 ppm. What safety considerations was this figure based on?

blocks.zh: Rayon & Polyester Pharmaceutical Coil — 嫘縈與聚酯藥用棉卷
blocks.en: Rayon & Polyester Pharmaceutical Coil

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 嫘縈的重大風險
blocks.en: Key Notes: Major Risk of Rayon

blocks.zh: 膠囊交叉鏈結問題（Gelatin Cross-linking）：USP 罕見地在正文中直接加入 Note 警告嫘縈棉卷可能導致明膠膠囊的溶出度問題。這個交叉鏈結現象會讓膠囊殼變硬，導致藥品釋放速率下降，影響生體可用率（bioavailability）。
blocks.en: Gelatin cross-linking problem: Unusually, USP adds a Note directly in the main text warning that rayon coil may cause dissolution problems in gelatin capsules. This cross-linking phenomenon hardens the capsule shell, slowing drug release and affecting bioavailability.

blocks.zh: 實務意涵：對 CDMO 而言，若客戶產品是明膠硬膠囊或明膠軟膠囊，選擇嫘縈棉卷必須格外謹慎，應進行相容性研究，最好改用棉或聚酯棉卷。
blocks.en: Practical implication: For a CDMO, if the client's product is a hard or soft gelatin capsule, selecting rayon coil requires particular caution. A compatibility study should be performed, and it is best to switch to cotton or polyester coil.

blocks.zh: 聚酯棉卷的鑑別方式從「化學反應」升級到「IR 指紋比對」，就像從「肉眼辨認長相」升級到「DNA 比對」。FTIR 提供的分子指紋是最精確的身份識別方式，無法偽造，這正是為什麼 USP 對合成聚合物選擇 IR 而非染色試驗。
blocks.en: The identification of polyester coil moves up from "chemical reaction" to "IR fingerprint comparison", like moving from "recognizing someone by sight" to "DNA matching". The molecular fingerprint from FTIR is the most precise means of identification and cannot be faked, which is why USP uses IR rather than staining tests for synthetic polymers.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 聚酯的 FDA 食品接觸法規
blocks.en: Key Notes: FDA Food Contact Regulations for Polyester

blocks.zh: "Finish on fibers" 要求：聚酯棉卷在製造過程中會使用潤滑劑（finish）以利加工，這些潤滑劑必須符合 FDA 的食品接觸法規（21 CFR）。這意味著供應商必須提供此類添加物的合規聲明，且 CDMO 在審核供應商時需確認其 FDA 合規文件。
blocks.en: "Finish on fibers" requirement: Lubricants (finish) are used during polyester coil manufacturing to aid processing, and these lubricants must comply with FDA food contact regulations (21 CFR). This means the supplier must provide a compliance statement for such additives, and the CDMO must confirm the supplier's FDA compliance documentation during supplier audits.

blocks.zh: 如果一個產品是明膠硬膠囊，你會建議使用哪種棉卷材質？為什麼？
blocks.en: If a product is a hard gelatin capsule, which coil material would you recommend, and why?

blocks.zh: 嫘縈與棉花在「溶於氯化鋅甲酸溶液」中的反應截然不同（嫘縈溶解，棉花不溶），這個差異的化學原理是什麼？
blocks.en: Rayon and cotton react very differently in "dissolving in zinc chloride-formic acid solution" (rayon dissolves, cotton does not). What is the chemical principle behind this difference?

blocks.zh: 聚酯棉卷的 Loss on Drying 限度（≤1.0%）遠低於棉花（≤8.0%）和嫘縈（≤11.0%），這說明了什麼？
blocks.en: The Loss on Drying limit for polyester coil (≤1.0%) is far lower than for cotton (≤8.0%) and rayon (≤11.0%). What does this tell us?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 三種棉卷的比較
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Comparison of the Three Coil Types

blocks.zh: Desiccants — 乾燥劑：概覽與膨潤土
blocks.en: Desiccants: Overview and Bentonite

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 乾燥劑的分類與原理
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Classification and Principles of Desiccants

blocks.zh: Desiccant（乾燥劑）：透過物理吸附或化學反應去除容器內水分的材料，是保護對濕度敏感的固體口服劑型最常用的輔助組件。
blocks.en: Desiccant: A material that removes moisture from inside a container by physical adsorption or chemical reaction; it is the most commonly used auxiliary component for protecting moisture-sensitive solid oral dosage forms.

blocks.zh: 六大 USP 認可乾燥劑：
blocks.en: Six USP-recognized desiccants:

blocks.zh: Bentonite（膨潤土）：天然鋁矽酸鹽，物理吸附，pH 4.5–10.5
blocks.en: Bentonite: Natural aluminum silicate, physical adsorption, pH 4.5–10.5

blocks.zh: Calcium Chloride（氯化鈣）：化學吸濕，吸附力強，≥28% at 80% RH
blocks.en: Calcium Chloride: Chemical moisture absorption, strong adsorption capacity, ≥28% at 80% RH

blocks.zh: Calcium Oxide（氧化鈣）：高吸附力，與水反應生成 Ca(OH)₂
blocks.en: Calcium Oxide: High adsorption capacity, reacts with water to form Ca(OH)₂

blocks.zh: Carbon, Activated（活性碳）：同時作為除臭劑，≥21% at 80% RH
blocks.en: Carbon, Activated: Also serves as an odor adsorbent, ≥21% at 80% RH

blocks.zh: Molecular Sieves（分子篩）：精確孔徑控制，3A/4A/5A/13X 型
blocks.en: Molecular Sieves: Precisely controlled pore size, types 3A/4A/5A/13X

blocks.zh: Silica Gel（矽膠）：最普遍，pH 4–8，≥19% at 40% RH
blocks.en: Silica Gel: The most common, pH 4–8, ≥19% at 40% RH

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 測試前的關鍵預處理
blocks.en: Key Notes: Critical Pretreatment Before Testing

blocks.zh: 兩個重要預處理原則：
blocks.en: Two important pretreatment principles:

blocks.zh: 1. 整合型乾燥劑（incorporated desiccants）：如直接嵌入瓶壁或瓶蓋的乾燥劑，測試時必須使用「未整合」（unincorporated）的同款乾燥劑進行測試，而非破壞原包裝提取。
blocks.en: 1. Incorporated desiccants: For desiccants embedded directly in the bottle wall or cap, the test must use the same desiccant in unincorporated form rather than extracting it by destroying the original packaging.

blocks.zh: 2. 預先加載水分的乾燥劑：必須在加載水分「之前」或「再生後」進行測試，確保測試的是乾燥劑原始能力，而非已飽和狀態。
blocks.en: 2. Desiccants preloaded with moisture: These must be tested before the moisture is loaded or after regeneration, to ensure that the test measures the desiccant's original capacity rather than a saturated state.

blocks.zh: 這兩項規定避免了測試結果低估乾燥劑實際能力的系統性偏差。
blocks.en: These two provisions avoid a systematic bias that would underestimate the desiccant's actual capacity in the test results.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 膨潤土的特殊性
blocks.en: Analogy: The Special Nature of Bentonite

blocks.zh: 膨潤土（Bentonite）是一種「智慧型海綿」——它吸水後體積膨脹，就像海綿吸水後膨脹一樣。X 光粉末繞射（XRD）測試中，d 值在 15–17 Å 代表晶格間距，水分子插入層間導致間距增大。科學家用 XRD 來「量測」這個海綿吸了多少水、確認是真正的膨潤土而非其他黏土礦物。
blocks.en: Bentonite is a "smart sponge": it swells in volume after absorbing water, just like a sponge. In X-ray powder diffraction (XRD) testing, a d-value of 15–17 Å represents the lattice spacing; water molecules inserting between the layers increase the spacing. Scientists use XRD to "measure" how much water the sponge has absorbed and to confirm that it is true bentonite rather than another clay mineral.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 重金屬限度的重要性
blocks.en: Key Notes: Importance of Heavy Metal Limits

blocks.zh: 砷（As）≤10 mg/kg，鉛（Pb）≤15 mg/kg：膨潤土是天然礦物，天然礦物必然含有重金屬雜質。USP 設定這兩個限度是因為：(1) 砷和鉛是最常見且毒性最高的無機污染物；(2) 藥品包裝中的重金屬可能在特定條件下遷移到藥品中。
blocks.en: Arsenic (As) ≤10 mg/kg, lead (Pb) ≤15 mg/kg: Bentonite is a natural mineral, and natural minerals inevitably contain heavy metal impurities. USP sets these two limits because (1) arsenic and lead are the most common and most toxic inorganic contaminants; and (2) heavy metals in pharmaceutical packaging may migrate into the drug product under certain conditions.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 採購團隊而言，這意味著每個批次的膨潤土供應都需要重金屬合規的 CoA。
blocks.en: For a CDMO procurement team, this means every batch of bentonite supplied requires a CoA demonstrating heavy metal compliance.

blocks.zh: 膨潤土的 Loss on Drying 試驗必須「開瓶後立即進行」，這個要求的科學依據是什麼？
blocks.en: The Loss on Drying test for bentonite must be performed "immediately after opening the bottle". What is the scientific basis for this requirement?

blocks.zh: 為什麼同一種乾燥劑要在兩個不同的濕度條件（40% RH 和 80% RH）分別測試吸附容量？
blocks.en: Why must the adsorption capacity of the same desiccant be tested separately under two different humidity conditions (40% RH and 80% RH)?

blocks.zh: 膨潤土的 pH 範圍相當寬（4.5–10.5），這對其適用的藥品類型有什麼限制？
blocks.en: Bentonite has a fairly wide pH range (4.5–10.5). What limitations does this place on the types of drug products it is suitable for?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: USP 〈670〉 定義輔助包裝組件為「支持或增強容器密封系統」的物品，包括藥用棉卷、乾燥劑、除臭吸附劑等，必須同時滿足本章及其他指定 USP 章節的要求
blocks.en: USP <670> defines auxiliary packaging components as items that "support or enhance the container-closure system", including pharmaceutical coil, desiccants, and odor adsorbents, which must meet the requirements of both this chapter and the other specified USP chapters

blocks.zh: 三種藥用棉卷（棉、嫘縈、聚酯）各有其獨特的鑑別試驗：棉用染色（綠）＋不溶於甲酸鋅；嫘縈用染色（藍綠）＋溶於甲酸鋅；聚酯用 FTIR 比對 RS，嫘縈特別警示可能導致明膠膠囊溶出問題
blocks.en: The three types of pharmaceutical coil (cotton, rayon, polyester) each have their own identification tests: cotton uses staining (green) plus insolubility in zinc chloride-formic acid; rayon uses staining (blue-green) plus solubility in zinc chloride-formic acid; polyester uses FTIR comparison against the RS. Rayon carries a special warning that it may cause dissolution problems in gelatin capsules

blocks.zh: 六種 USP 認可乾燥劑（膨潤土、氯化鈣、氧化鈣、活性碳、分子篩、矽膠）各有其化學特性、吸附容量規格及重金屬限度要求，測試前需注意整合型乾燥劑的預處理規定
blocks.en: The six USP-recognized desiccants (bentonite, calcium chloride, calcium oxide, activated carbon, molecular sieves, silica gel) each have their own chemical properties, adsorption capacity specifications, and heavy metal limit requirements; before testing, attention must be paid to the pretreatment rules for incorporated desiccants

blocks.zh: 所有乾燥劑的吸附容量測試需在兩個標準濕度條件（40% RH 和 80% RH，25±2°C）下進行，且需在開瓶後立即執行以避免預先吸濕導致結果偏低
blocks.en: The adsorption capacity test for all desiccants must be performed under two standard humidity conditions (40% RH and 80% RH, 25±2°C) and immediately after opening the bottle, to avoid pre-absorbed moisture causing falsely low results
